_doc: Cross-major overrides accepted on purpose, keyed by package directory (the keys are also the only directories check-override-ranges.mjs runs from). Fields: `override` is the package.json#overrides key; `consumer` the lockfile path that declares the package; `gets` the range the override resolves it to (the override's value); `ghsa` the advisory; `why` the reasoning and the retirement condition. The range mode prints the matching mismatch as `accepted` (exit 0); `--overrides` prints the key `live (accepted …)` while something still declares it and `STALE` once nothing does, for a human to retire with this entry. The scan never edits this file. Tests point the script at their own copy through ACCEPTED_OVERRIDES_FILE. Reasoning: docs/automation/daily-upgrade-scan.md, 'Accepted cross-major overrides'.

backend.why: Every deepmerge-ts below 8.0.0 is vulnerable and no patched 7.x exists; Prisma 7.10.1 itself declares 8.0.2, so the API is compatible. Retire when Prisma is bumped to a release that declares 8.x: that bump turns backend/tests/infra/check-override-ranges.test.ts red (the real-lockfile test expects this accepted line), and the fix is to remove the override, this entry and that test's expectation in the same PR (#890, #923).
